peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (36.0): 2.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 137 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 9). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Parade MRT about 180 m, Tanjong Katong MRT about 770 m; closer than 586 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 420 m; more than 621 of 662 similar developments (the same as 41). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 90 m), more than 362 of 662 similar developments (the same as 63); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 350 m; nearest park Marine Parade Rd Park about 190 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 420 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 560 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 630 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 780 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 940 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 1,090 m; Claydence, 8 new sales, about 1,110 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,190 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 410 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 389 new sales and 863 resales (1,252 purchases); new sales were 31.1% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 863 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 415 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 863 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,005 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14.1%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
